reviews.text: I have been using this vet's services for many years now. Their prices are very competitive compared to other clinics. It was my first time visiting the Amsterdam location and I am very satisfied. Starting from the phone contact all the way to the visit itself, everything was great. The receptionists were very nice and helpful, and the vet was truly the right person for the job. He kept me informed about everything and explained things clearly. Top-class care. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

I previously left a 1 star review about this practice 11 months ago regarding a missed appointment fee. I had never received confirmation of the appointment, yet was charged for supposedly missing it. The practice responded publicly and asked me to contact them to resolve it. When I later brought my cat in, I was specifically told not to worry about the previous payment, so I genuinely believed the matter had been resolved.

Unfortunately, almost a year later, I was suddenly told there was still an outstanding bill, supposedly because there were two accounts registered to the same address. Despite this, I received no communication about it for the entire year.

What happened next has honestly left me shocked and extremely disappointed.

I had just rescued a 10 week old kitten that same day and discovered that he was infested with fleas. I went into the practice specifically to get flea treatment for him. I was then told that because of the outstanding bill, they would not give me the flea medication and I would not be allowed to make any further appointments until the bill was paid.

It was 17:30 on a Friday. I initially walked out, but then came back because I was not prepared to leave a 10 week old kitten infested with fleas until Monday simply because I could no longer get to another vet that evening. I ultimately paid the bill because I was determined to get the treatment he needed.

When I questioned how a veterinary practice could allow a 10 week old kitten to leave without flea treatment, I was told by the receptionist that it was my responsibility.

Of course my animals are my responsibility. But I find it absolutely shocking that a veterinary practice would refuse treatment for a 10 week old rescued kitten over a disputed outstanding bill, particularly when I had not been contacted about that bill for almost a year. I was not offered the opportunity to speak to a manager, make a complaint, or given any alternative solution. I was simply refused.

This is also not my first negative experience. When my cat previously came in after I found a lump on his neck, we paid a significant amount for investigations, yet I felt the situation was unnecessarily prolonged. The lump was eventually found to be cancerous, which was incredibly upsetting.

I have now made a formal complaint and requested that this situation be properly investigated.

I am genuinely appalled and deeply disappointed by the way this was handled. Whatever the situation with the account, I find it incredibly difficult to understand how a veterinary practice could knowingly allow a 10 week old kitten to remain infested with fleas because of a billing dispute, especially when the issue appears to have stemmed from the practice’s own lack of communication and organisation.

After my previous experience and now this, I have completely lost confidence in this practice. I will never be returning.

Thank you for your review!

Kind regards,

Ranzijn Garden & Pet🌱

Thank you very much for your lovely review!

Kind regards,

Ranzijn Garden & Pet🌱

The actual vets are great but the front desk people and whoever emails are not nice at all.

The front desk lady told me when my appointment was and I never received a confirmation email or text.

Now I receive an email 2 days before the date I was told, informing me that I missed the appointment and that I need to pay for the missed appointment. I informed them that I never received and email or text message and that I was very clearly told Thursday.

I told them that something very clearly went wrong and I’d be happy to compensate some of it but they refused and wanted the full amount being 60+ euros for nail trimming!!!

This is a money driven vet yes they charge a bit less than other vets in some cases but they will sneakily add charges, inform you that they sent emails when clearly something in the system went wrong, they don’t care about their customers at all and don’t show kindness or a sense of understanding, they don’t even try to communicate.

I will not be coming back to this vet, trust me there are much better ones!

I was at your place on Sunday, September 28th, to have our rat put to sleep. Two weeks before that, I was at Ranzijn Aalsmeer because I had our other rat put to sleep there as well. Within two weeks, you have become 50 euros more expensive; I find this absolutely ridiculous. The vet was really super nice, but the chair is the absolute worst thing you want to experience. I give the vet 5 stars.

Very good doctors, but the waiting room has the most terrible chairs to sit in, and I think the prices are getting very high in a short time. Two weeks ago I had a pet rat put to sleep, and yesterday another one; it was 45 euros more expensive, which I thought was quite a lot.

I received excellent help from veterinarian Dr. Doortje Stolp. She listens to your story, thinks along with you, does what is necessary, explains the diagnosis (including X-rays), and last but not least, provides follow-ups over the phone several times to check on how Boy, an American Staffordshire Terrier who is nearly 14 years old, is doing, as well as administering his "lifelong" medication. I hope to enjoy Boy for a few more weeks, or preferably months. Naturally, with a good quality of life. Thank you again, Veterinarian Dr. Doortje Stolp, for your compassion and thoughtful approach.

I'm very satisfied with Ranzijn Amsterdam, especially veterinarians Janneke and Lisa. My cat was in very bad shape, but thanks to the excellent care, she recovered. It wasn't easy to tube-feed her. Fortunately, she started eating again afterward. The approach of these two veterinarians undoubtedly also helped. They took all the time for Lotteke and were always very kind, proactive, and thorough. Thank you!

We are pleased with your positive review. Thank you!

Kind regards,

Ranzijn Garden & Pet🌱

Thank you so much for your review! 🙌

We are very happy with the vet - specifically: Giulia from Italy. I have been to several vets, and Giulia is the best! Very professional and also really cares about the animals! Highly recommended. I come all the way from Limburg to Amsterdam for check ups of my pets. Specifically to Giulia. Great Vet 👍 👌 …
Very skilled and kind veterinarians and veterinary assistants!
I had to have my dog ​​put to sleep nine weeks ago. I had filed a complaint about a veterinarian. It's a shame about this. I was always well helped by the doctors, but with this doctor, it's a pity.
Received excellent help, good explanation, kind to my dog ​​Kenzo, very good vet Lisa took her time, very satisfied.
Very friendly team i highly recommend the place
We take our dog to have a shower at Ranzijn. Always great service

Thank you for everything.
Today we unfortunately had to put our Rambo to sleep at your place.
Thank you for the wonderful care and love you gave us.

Dear All,

Following my Chihuahua's recent surgery at Veterinarian Ranzijn on Spaklerweg in Amsterdam, I can only leave you with a beautiful gift, filled with love. I'm very grateful to Dr. Christa and everyone who works here, who meticulously helped me and my dog ​​through the surgery process, which was also a resounding success. It's such a relief to be reassured step by step by everyone. Thank you, Toppers!

Lots of love from Nathalie and paws from Tony, who is 12 years old. Thanks to all of you, the wonderful team can continue to provide loving care. I wish everyone the same with a sweet, beautiful pet!

Thank you for your review! We are happy that you are satisfied with our veterinarian and the staff. We hope to see you and your pets again soon!

Kind regards,
Ranzijn Tuin & Dier Customer Service

Unfortunately, we had to have our dog put to sleep this weekend and ended up at Ranzijn in Amsterdam.

What a loving experience this turned out to be, however sad the farewell was.

Charlotte passed away very peacefully. The veterinarian explained everything that was going to happen very calmly, which was comforting to me. The assistant was stroking her reassuringly while the veterinarian did her work.
We had to leave the dog behind because we could only bury her later, and we picked her up on Tuesday. I was pleasantly surprised by how they 'laid out' Charlotte: while she lay stretched out on her belly with her paws forward during the procedure, she is now curled up as if she is sleeping. Very nice and natural.
Thank you, dear Ranzijn people, for handling this sad procedure with such respect and love.
Thank you for your review. We are pleased to hear that you are so satisfied with us. … More

We had to drive all the way from Leiden with our cat for a heart ultrasound. Luckily, a spot opened up on short notice, and she was able to get the procedure done. The vet and staff were incredibly kind to our pet.

Received excellent service. Normally I always go to Velserbroek, but after my appointment for the sterilization of my cat was cancelled there twice due to a sick vet, I was able to get an appointment in Amsterdam that same week. I also had good and clear contact via email after the treatment.
Always a pleasant visit with my cat Aisha that suffers from GI and kidney issues. Kind and knowledgeable veterinarians who even call to check up whether the animal is ok. 🥰 …
Outstanding professionals with a very attentive approach to customers and aftercare.
Easily accessible and proactive
